title: Native WiFi search on Chromatic
body: This original sample explains the handheld search flow. Type wifi, then press Start. The device contacts the companion over verified HTTPS and receives one ranked result per screen. Up and Down change the selected result. A opens the stored article, Left and Right change its text page, and B returns to the result. The Rust engine ranks this collection independently. These are sample documents, not crawled web pages. No bookmarks or browsing history are stored. A small display can show a complete article through bounded pages. title: Rust reader and memory bounds
body: This original sample describes an allocation-free Rust packet decoder. It validates UTF-8, line widths, pagination, and the 512-byte packet boundary before the screen changes. WiFi and HTTPS buffers belong to the firmware adapter. A host benchmark is different from a physical device measurement.
